notes: HomeStop is Shoppers Stop's home-goods vertical, living entirely inside the shared shoppersstop.com marketplace at categoryPath1='Home' (department landing /category/Homestop). No separate homestop.com/.in domain exists. robots.txt explicitly Allow:/ for ClaudeBot/Claude-SearchBot/Claude-User/claude-web (only /checkout,/cart,/login,/account,/orders,/payment disallowed), so direct in-tab access was used. Access route: opened the site in a Chrome tab and drove the site's own Unbxd (Mimir) search-as-a-service index via same-origin fetch() from the loaded page (javascript_tool), calling https://search.unbxd.io/579c6c9e792e43e038e7f40ca11b6103/ss-unbxd-aapac-shoppersstop-dev50901709028198/search with categoryPath*_uFilter/pro_type_uFilter facet queries and rows=0 to read exact live facet counts -- this is the site's own live search index, not a scraped or rounded widget. Note: combining multiple categoryPath filters with the '#' AND-separator in a raw fetch() call did not restrict results correctly in this session (it silently fell back to the outer/unfiltered count), so each node was instead queried with a SINGLE categoryPath/pro_type filter clause at a time; category and pro_type label strings on this site are unique across the whole Home department (spot-checked: lone categoryPath3 filter values matched the values already returned by the categoryPath1=Home-scoped facet listing), so single-clause filtering was equivalent and safe here, and the single-clause numberOfProducts was corroborated against the rendered page header for the one leaf found (see below). EXHAUSTIVE TREE COVERAGE: pulled the full categoryPath2 facet under categoryPath1=Home (9 buckets: Bedding 1956, Dining 1438, Living 1266, Kitchen 929, Decor 812, Bath & Laundry 723, Home & Kitchen Appliances 34, Accessories 25, Music Collections 2) and the full categoryPath3 facet under categoryPath1=Home in one call, which returned all 35 categoryPath3 nodes across the entire department in a single unbounded list (limit=100, no truncation) -- this is exhaustive by construction since it is the department's own live product index, not a nav crawl that could under-report. Scanned all 35 categoryPath3 names for furniture: Bed Sheets, Curtains, Quilts Comforters & Dohars, Storage Solution, Towels, Cushions Covers & Fillers, Fragrance Candles and Holders, Tea & Coffee, Drinkware, Cookware & Bakeware, Bath Accessories, Dinnerware, Floor Coverings, Cutlery, Food Preps & Tools, Vases & Flowers, Serveware, Garden, Idols & Figurines, Cushions, Pillows, Table Tops, Table Linens, Kitchen Appliances, Laundry, Wall Decor, Umbrella, Table & Kitchen Linens, Decor Accents, Ottomans, Dining Table Cover, Covers & Protectors, HYBE Music Albums, Home Appliances, Lamps, Sofa Covers & Throws -- only 'Ottomans' is furniture-shaped. Additionally pulled pro_type facet breakdowns (with product-title spot checks) for every plausible mixed-bucket candidate to rule out hidden furniture: Storage Solution (419; pro_types are all kitchen jars/containers/canisters/caseroles/lunch boxes/racks-holders -- titles for 'Racks & Holders' confirmed spice/lunch-box storage jars, not furniture racks), Garden (132; Potted Arrangements + Showpieces only), Table Tops (73; trays/coasters/organizers/trivets), Decor Accents (9; Showpieces only), Bath Accessories (301; bath mats/accessories/soaps/shower curtains/toilet brush holders, no vanity units or bathroom cabinets). No Sofas, Chairs, Tables (dining/coffee/side/console), Beds, Wardrobes, Dressers, Cabinets, Bookcases, TV/media units, Benches, Stools, or Desks exist anywhere as a categoryPath3 or pro_type in this department. The single furniture node found, Ottomans (categoryPath2=Living > categoryPath3=Ottomans, 8 products), was verified by navigating the actual site URL: rendered listing header read '8 Products' with breadcrumb Home > Living > Ottomans, exactly matching the Unbxd facet count; all 8 titles are genuine HomeStop-branded storage/rib ottomans (e.g. 'HomeStop Masimo Dusty Pink Rib Ottoman', 'HomeStop Masimo Rib Storage Green Ottoman'), confirming true furniture/seating, not a mislabeled textile. Sanity checks: qty (8) is small and specific, not a round/capped number; the categoryPath3=Storage Solution single-filter count (419) matched the value already present in the categoryPath1=Home-scoped facet list, confirming label uniqueness held for the safe single-clause substitution. The department landing page /category/Homestop shows a smaller decorative tile set (Dining, Kitchen, Bedding, Decor, Appliances, Bath & Laundry) that omits 'Living' entirely -- this is a marketing banner strip, not the authoritative category tree, and was superseded by the exhaustive search-index facet enumeration described above. Excluded per scope: all Bedding/textile/tableware/appliance/lighting/decor nodes (out of scope per brief section 1); the 'Sofa Covers & Throws' (1) and 'Dining Table Cover' (5) categoryPath3 nodes are furniture COVERS/textiles, not furniture itself, and were excluded. Only one row emitted; no grouping row was needed since Ottomans is a single leaf directly under a categoryPath2 that has no other furniture siblings to group.
